title: Proceed to checkout after signing in
description: A returning customer can sign in, complete checkout details, and receive an order confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign in form
Navigate to /checkout
Fill the delivery details fields with valid information
Submit the payment
Verify an order confirmation is visible

title: Complete checkout with delivery details and payment
description: A signed-in customer can enter delivery details, submit checkout, and see an order completion confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /checkout
Fill in the delivery details form with valid information
Submit the checkout form
Verify an order completion confirmation is visible

title: Add a product to the cart from its detail page
description: A shopper can add a product from its detail page and see it appear in the cart.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Click a product card to open its detail page
Add the product to the cart
Open the cart page
Verify the item appears in the cart
Verify the cart total is displayed

title: Sign in from checkout and continue purchasing
description: An anonymous shopper who reaches checkout can sign in and continue without losing access to checkout.

steps.description: Navigate to /checkout
Start the sign in flow
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign in form
Verify the checkout page is displayed
Verify delivery details can be entered

title: Require sign in before checkout
description: An anonymous shopper who opens checkout is prompted to sign in before completing the purchase.

steps.description: Navigate to /checkout
Verify a sign in prompt is visible
Verify checkout is not available until sign in

title: Review cart contents before checkout
description: A shopper can open the cart and confirm the selected items and total are visible before purchasing.

steps.description: Navigate to /cart
Verify cart line items are displayed
Verify the cart total is displayed

title: Update cart quantity and see totals recalculate
description: A shopper can change an item quantity in the cart and see the cart totals update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /cart
Change an item quantity
Verify the updated quantity is displayed
Verify the cart total is updated

title: Remove an item from the cart
description: A shopper can remove an item from the cart and see the cart update without that line item.

steps.description: Navigate to /cart
Remove an item from the cart
Verify the item is removed from the cart
Verify the cart updates accordingly

title: Browse products from the shop catalog
description: A shopper can open the shop catalog, review the product listing, and reach a product detail page.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Click a product card to open its detail page
Verify product images are displayed
Verify option selectors are displayed

title: Review a product before buying
description: A shopper can open a product detail page from the catalog and inspect the product presentation before purchase.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Click a product card to open its detail page
Verify the product detail page is displayed
Verify product details are displayed

title: Choose a quantity on a product page
description: A shopper can change the quantity selection on a product page and see the selection update.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Click a product card to open its detail page
Change the quantity selection
Verify the updated quantity selection is displayed

title: Show validation when checkout details are incomplete
description: A signed-in customer who submits checkout with missing delivery details sees validation feedback and cannot complete checkout.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign in form
Navigate to /checkout
Submit the payment with incomplete delivery details
Verify delivery validation feedback is visible
Verify the order confirmation is not shown
